Samples whose depth is far from the rest

Source: R/qc-depth.R
qc_depth_outliers.Rd

Flagged on the ratio to the median rather than an absolute count: what counts as a shallow library depends entirely on the experiment, and a fixed threshold would be wrong for every study but one.

Usage

qc_depth_outliers(depth_df, min_ratio = 0.3)

Arguments

depth_df

Output of qc_depth().

min_ratio

Flag samples below this fraction of the median.

Value

Character vector of sample ids.

See also
